designationHistory.indexText: Northern Tallgrass Prairie National Wildlife Refuge was established in 2000 to address the loss of America’s grasslands and the decline of grassland wildlife.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
